snippet.title: Mr Bump iPhone Promo
snippet.description:
The trouble with Mr Bump is that he has never featured in his very own iPhone Game..... Until Now!

That's right, the worldwide renowned Mr Men and Little Miss characters have finally made their way to the App Store.

Brought to you by Digital Goldfish, in association with Chorion, Mr Bump is the first in a series of games playable on your iPhone / iPod Touch.
